user.title: Choose the source entity
user.description: Select the source entity to link. The custom cover entity will be placed under the same device and will show its current position.

data_description.source_entity: The cover entity that receives the commands.

parametres.title: Cover settings
parametres.description: Source entity: {source}. Time a complete trip of the cover, fully closed to fully open and back.

data.name: Entity name
data.take_over: Take over the name and identifier of the source entity
data.disable_other_entities: Disable the other entities of the source device

data_description.name: The name shown in Home Assistant. Keep the name of the source entity to take over its identifier (see below).
data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening (0 to 100 %).
data_description.travel_time_down: Seconds needed for a complete closing (100 to 0 %).
data_description.send_stop_at_ends: Once opening or closing is complete, still sends a stop command. This is only useful if the cover does not stop by itself at the end of its travel. When in doubt, don't use it.
data_description.device_class: The type of equipment (shutter, blind, door…). It determines the icon.
data_description.hide_source: The source entity no longer appears in Home Assistant's automatic screens. It is still used internally to run the commands, and it appears again if you remove this entity.
data_description.take_over: On: the custom cover entity takes the name and identifier of the source entity (for example cover.kitchen_shutter), and the source entity is renamed with the suffix below. Your scripts and automations then use the custom cover entity without any change. Off: the custom cover entity gets a different identifier (for example cover.kitchen_shutter_2) and your scripts must be edited to use it. The exchange only happens if the name entered above is the name of the source entity.
data_description.source_suffix: Added to the name and identifier of the source entity when it is renamed (for example "source" gives "Kitchen Shutter (source)" and cover.kitchen_shutter_source). No effect if the option above is off.
data_description.disable_other_entities: Disables all the other entities of the source device (for example Somfy's "My Position" or "Identify" buttons, which move the cover without going through the custom cover entity and make it lose position tracking). The source entity stays enabled: it receives the commands. Careful: the device's sensors (battery, power…) are disabled too. Everything is enabled again if you untick the option or remove the custom cover entity.

positions.name: Preset positions
positions.description: A preset position creates a button that moves the cover entity to that position, placed under the same device. Unlike an original button such as Somfy's "My Position", the position stays up to date. The positions also become the favorites in the entity's control dialog, between 0 % and 100 % (max. 8 positions).

error.source_introuvable: This cover entity cannot be found.
error.suffixe_invalide: Enter a suffix made of letters or digits.
error.positions_invalides: Each preset position needs a name and a percentage between 0 and 100.
error.noms_en_double: This name is already used for a position of this entity.

init.title: Cover settings
init.description: Changes apply immediately. The current position is kept. The name and the name exchange can only be set when the entity is created.
